limitations: This post-hoc comparison uses four-decimal source projections from the frozen public return.
The overlap of marginal intervals is descriptive. It supplies no joint uncertainty estimate and does not test the difference between cards.
Each card is scored under each other model's marginal expectations on the same fixed games. These are sensitivity diagnostics, not observed contest points.
No cross-model consensus card, production approval or new fit was issued.
